items.item: All four SKUs' flat and closed boards follow the structural, copy and variant records without conflicting dimensions, material assignments, copy or codes.
The four product families share the prescribed base colours and readable identification hierarchy while keeping each assigned accent and purchase or bottle message distinct.
Each open starter preserves its closed family's bottle, cartridge, carton, artwork and removable closure designs despite the change in assembly state.
Every opened starter contains one empty dedicated bottle and one sealed matching cartridge, with the shared P20 geometry and specified materials.
Sequence and retail imagery preserve the corresponding assembled product designs, labels, matching codes and SKU accents.
The four sequences apply one P20 station process while retaining each matching bottle, and retail imagery consistently separates starter and refill purchases from the existing station.

Any exposed or dimensioned connector must agree with P20: bottle collar OD 28 mm, opening 18 mm and band height 10 mm; cartridge shoulder 28 mm; stem OD 16 mm, bore 8 mm and insertion length 14 mm. Body silhouettes and closure exteriors may vary. Concealed geometry need not be exposed on every board, but a contradictory dimension, incompatible connector or SKU-specific replacement interface fails.

The starter's visible contents or readable contents statement must identify one empty 500 mL dedicated bottle and one sealed 20 mL concentrate cartridge with matching numeric codes: S01/B01/R01, S02/B02/R02, S03/B03/R03 or S04/B04/R04 as appropriate. Closed cartons and flat artwork may establish contents through their copy. Filled starter bottles, mismatched codes, extra contents presented as included, or a refill sold as including a new bottle fail.

Docking and transfer must occur at a neutral, visibly delineated boundary labelled RETURNHOUSE refill station. Its drawing style may vary, but it must read as existing equipment separate from either purchased pack. An unlabelled boundary, direct pouring that bypasses the station, or depiction of the station as included fails.

The upstream structural record must state collar OD/opening/band height 28/18/10 mm, cartridge shoulder 28 mm and stem OD/bore/insertion 16/8/14 mm; 500 mL bottle capacity and 20 mL concentrate contents; HDPE bottles, PP cartridges and removable closures, and 350 g/m² uncoated folding paperboard cartons. Include bottle/cartridge/carton maximum W/D/H of 70/65/230, 60/32/110 and 145/90/255 mm, closure-inclusive extents, and 50 × 90/40 × 55 mm front/back label outlines with 2 mm radii and 3 mm text insets. Formatting may vary; absent or conflicting structural facts fail.

Record all front and back lines for B01–B04, R01–R04 and S01–S04 exactly as supplied in 01-client-facts.en.md, assigning each line to its item and surface. Locate 2 HDPE on bottle backs, 5 PP on cartridge backs and closure undersides, and 21 PAP on carton backs. Table layout may vary; missing BATH records, altered wording, incorrect pairings or ambiguous placements fail.

Require four unambiguous records: 01 PANE, Glass cleaner, #3C77A0, B01/R01/S01; 02 SURFACE, Surface cleaner, #BD714D, B02/R02/S02; 03 FLOOR, Floor cleaner, #5B7F64, B03/R03/S03; and 04 BATH, Bathroom cleaner, #845E87, B04/R04/S04. Column arrangement may vary; omitted records, swapped accents, incorrect categories or unmatched codes fail.

Every flat and closed board must provide readable complete front/back copy for its B/R/S trio, correct back-surface material marks, and annotations repeating label sizes, 500 mL/20 mL figures and all material assignments. Closed boards must contain the dedicated bottle, sealed refill and closed starter carton plus flat labels. Consumer fronts must carry RETURNHOUSE, the correct code/name, and DEDICATED BOTTLE, REFILL ONLY or STARTER KIT as appropriate. Match each variant's accent and the #F7F5EF/#233D45 base. Wrapping and composition may vary; omissions, incorrect surface assignments or deviations from the records fail.

Each open carton view must reveal its one empty dedicated bottle, one matching sealed cartridge and removable storage closures while preserving the corresponding closed board's product forms and artwork. Visible fronts must retain RETURNHOUSE, matching codes and the correct bottle or purchase label; visible backs must carry the corresponding material marks, with 5 PP on any exposed closure underside. Pose and unpacking arrangement may vary. Filled bottles, broken cartridge seals, missing closures, mismatched components or contradictory visible copy fail.

Flat boards must dimension both bottle labels at 50 W × 90 H mm and both cartridge labels at 40 W × 55 H mm, showing 2 mm corner radii, 3 mm text insets and complete carton dielines with folds, glue areas and assembled dimensions. Across artwork and assembled views, dimension evidence must preserve P20 and bottle/cartridge/carton maximum W/D/H of 70/65/230, 60/32/110 and 145/90/255 mm. Package envelopes include storage closures and refer to assembled packages, not unpacking spreads. Body and carton forms may vary within these limits; absent required dimensions or incompatible geometry fail.

Each board must use its own B01/R01, B02/R02, B03/R03 or B04/R04 pair in four ordered panels: retain the empty bottle and select a sealed matching cartridge, dock at P20, perform enclosed transfer, then remove and reclose the same bottle with the spent cartridge separated. Panel 3 must print '20 mL concentrate + 480 mL station carrier = 500 mL working fill'; each board must print 'Refill station required; not included in either pack.' Camera angle and panel layout may vary; reused wrong-SKU panels, new replacement bottles, open pouring or missing required text fail.

Review the entire 10-second video. The PANE unboxing must visibly reuse the submitted S01/B01/R01 designs and reveal one empty B01 bottle and one sealed R01 cartridge. Its ending must show all four product families with each family's bottle, refill and starter grouped under matching numeric codes, names and accents. Editing and camera motion may vary; incorrect duration, changed source designs, wrong contents, omitted families or mixed codes fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require exactly one each of S01–S03 and R01–R03 in the combined display, one S01/R01 pair in PANE and one S04/R04 pair in BATH. Dimensioned W/D/H must not exceed 600/300/450 mm for combined or 260/220/330 mm for either single-SKU display. Combined may use one or two rows. All packs must match their assembled sources, and each display must separate STARTER KIT and REFILL ONLY purchase headings and print 'Refill station required; not included.' Display construction may vary; wrong counts, changed packaging, excessive dimensions or missing text fail.

Require at least twelve pages with RETURNHOUSE on page one. Specification spreads must repeat all seven P20 dimensions, HDPE bottles, PP cartridges/closures, 350 g/m² uncoated folding paperboard cartons, correctly associated 2 HDPE/5 PP/21 PAP marks, 500 mL and 20 mL quantities, #F7F5EF/#233D45 and all four SKU names, categories, accents and matching B/R/S codes. Layout and spread allocation may vary; missing, unreadable or contradictory records fail.

Find identifiable reuse from every listed source, covering all three specification documents, all four SKUs' artwork, both closed and open packaging views, each sequence and display, and stills from the delivered video. Cropping, scaling and recomposition are allowed while source identity remains recognizable. Category titles without source evidence, replacement designs or omitted sources fail.

All four SKUs' flat and closed boards follow the structural, copy and variant records without conflicting dimensions, material assignments, copy or codes. The four product families share the prescribed base colours and readable identification hierarchy while keeping each assigned accent and purchase or bottle message distinct.

Each open starter preserves its closed family's bottle, cartridge, carton, artwork and removable closure designs despite the change in assembly state. Every opened starter contains one empty dedicated bottle and one sealed matching cartridge, with the shared P20 geometry and specified materials.

Sequence and retail imagery preserve the corresponding assembled product designs, labels, matching codes and SKU accents. The four sequences apply one P20 station process while retaining each matching bottle, and retail imagery consistently separates starter and refill purchases from the existing station.
